name: Parmigiano Reggiano - 24 month
description: The king of Italian cheese, and one that belongs in your refrigerator 100% of the time - and it does not come in a green can. Parmigiano-Reggiano's different stages of maturity are recognized by aging seals given at 18, 24 and 30 months - this one is the 24 month version. You can grate or shave Parmigiano on just about anything except your fish; it is also underused as a table cheese. When you have grated all the paste you can, save the rind for flavoring stocks, soups and braises!

name: DeLaurenti Grated Blend
description: Our famous house blend of Parmesan and Romano. Grated for ease and ready to use.

name: Grana Padano DOP
description: From the Emilia-Romagna region in Northern Italy, Grana Padano is made with raw cow's milk and aged an average of 16 to 18 months. Akin to Parmigiano-Reggiano, its first name, Grana, was bestowed upon it for its granular texture. Its last name, Padano, refers to the Po Valley Plain where it is produced. It is firm with a thick rind, and a straw yellow, granular paste. While it has just enough moisture to make an excellent table cheese, Grana Padano is usually grated or shaved on pasta and salads, or used as an ingredient.

name: Moliterno al Tartufo
tagline: Pasteurized Sheep - Central Formaggi - Sardinia, Italy
description: One of the most striking cheeses in our case, Moliterno al Tartufo looks more like rough cut marble than cheese. This is a result of the unique way of incorporating the truffle flavoring to the cheese. Made on the Italian island of Sardinia with raw sheep's milk, the unflavored cheese is partially aged, and then pierced and injected with ribbons of black truffle paste. As the truffle paste moves through the cracks and crevices of the cheese, it creates a distinct marble design. Although the truffle presence is assertive, it remains in balance with the cheese itself. It has a pronounced aroma of truffles and earth with a pleasant crumbly texture.

name: Parmigiano Reggiano Cravero
tagline: Raw Cow - Essex St. Cheese/Cravero - Bra, Italy
description: This Parmigiano Reggiano begins with the milk of cows that graze among the mountains of Benedello di Pavullo, one of very few Parms made exclusively from mountain pasture milk. After 13 months of aging at the San Pietro dairy, Giorgio Cravero selects wheels to move to his cheese hall in Bra, Italy, where his family has been aging Parmigiano Reggiano since 1855. Cravero continues to age the cheese for a minimum of 24 months. During this time, he and his team flip the wheels every other week, much more frequently than is typical for Parmigiano Reggiano. The result is a cheese with an exceptionally smooth, creamy texture. With notes of butter, tropical fruit, grass, and freshly baked bread, this Parmigiano is equally at home on a cheese board as it is in your favorite dish. Pair it with a sparkling white wine for a simple indulgence!

name: Parmigiano Reggiano Vacche Rosse
tagline: Raw Cow - Latteria Soresina - Emilia-Romagna, Italy
description: This unique Parmigiano is made exclusively from the milk of the Reggiana breed of cow, known for its beautiful red coat. This cheese tastes like the Parmigiano-Reggiano of days gone by. It is higher in butterfat and natural proteins, producing a more fruity, nutty and grassy flavor that surpasses traditional Parmigiano Reggiano. Reserve for special dishes, or eating on its own with cured meats and aged balsamic vinegar.

name: Pecorino Ginepro
description: Pecorino Ginepro is one of the most unique cheeses in our case. For the first month of aging this semi-firm, sheep's milk cheese is bathed in balsamic vinegar and juniper berries, then aged in oak barrels. The resulting rind is a mottled brown while the paste remains bone white with a slightly granular and flaky texture. Flavors are rich, sweet & herbal with aromas of earth and fruit.

name: Pecorino Romano Fulvi DOP
tagline: Raw Sheep - Sini Fulvi - Lazio, Italy
description: What was once rationed to Roman legionnaires is now a staple in Italian households. Sini Fulvi's Pecorino Romano bears the "Genuino" label, signifying that it is produced in Lazio, the area surrounding Rome. Aged 10 months to 1 year and coated in black wax per tradition, Fulvi is in a class by itself. What separates Fulvi from other Pecorino Romanos is the higher butterfat content of the whole (not skimmed) sheep’s milk. This gives the cheese more moisture than its Sardinian counterparts. Although great eaten as is, it is made to grate on pastas & salads. An indispensable ingredient in your Bucatini all’Amatriciana.

name: Pecorino Romano Locatelli
description: Locatelli's version of Pecorino Romano is one of the finest. This ancient cheese is made with 100% sheep's milk and aged a minimum of 9 months. The result is a cheese that is dry, sharp and spicy; making it one of the world's great grating cheeses. Perfect on pasta, salads & pizza. It also pairs wonderfully with pears, apples, hazelnuts & honey.

name: Pecorino Sardo
tagline: Pasteurized Sheep - Central Formaggi - Sardinia, Italy
description: Pecorino Sardo is produced on the island of Sardinia off the west coast of Italy. Historically, this sheep's milk cheese was produced by sheperds in small mountain huts known as "pinnette". The natural smoke from the hut's central, open fires gives the cheese its characteristically smoky overtones. The texture of the outer rind of Pecorino Sardo is dry and hard and, depending on age, a pale golden-rust color or a deep rich burnt brown. The texture of the cheese is very firm and dense and straw-ivory in color. Flavors are sweet, rich and nut-like with notes of burned caramel, smoke and salt.

name: Piccolo Canestrato
tagline: Pasteurized Sheep - Central Formaggi - Sardinia, Italy
description: Made from 100% sheep's milk, Canestrato is a great all-around pecorino. Produced in Sardinia, it is just as good on a cheese board as it is as a grating cheese. Semi-firm and slightly crumbly in texture, it has a nice balance of salt and sweet, finishing with a pleasant spice. The rind features distinctive hatch marks left by its traditional wicker basket mold during aging.
